$comment: Foundry-owned identity decision record. Not ASA authority. One record per resolved identity, answering 'why do we think these references are the same object?' with evidence rather than only a verdict. Records are carried inside immutable packages, so decision history accumulates by package accretion and is never rewritten in place.
title: UAO Foundry Identity Decision

reference.$comment: What was resolved. A resolution key or uid is a direct address; an external identifier is durable third-party evidence; an alias is only a hint and can never establish sameness.

decision.$comment: Three-valued by design. UNRESOLVED is a first-class outcome, not a failure, and absence of a match yields UNRESOLVED rather than DIFFERENT.

uid.$comment: Present only on SAME. A decision that could not establish sameness must not bind a uid.

candidateUids.$comment: Registered identities the evidence pointed at, including when the pointing was ambiguous. Surfacing the ambiguity is the point.

sourceRefs.$comment: Evidence custody. Which acquired sources supported the references this decision was made over.
